name: Fraction Carrom
tagline: Strike, pocket, simplify — the classic carrom board rebuilt around equivalent fractions.

steps.title: Set the board
steps.text: Arrange the fraction coins in the centre circle. Each coin shows a fraction — halves, thirds, quarters, fifths and their equivalents.

steps.title: Call your target
steps.text: Before striking, announce the fraction family you are hunting, e.g. “I pocket coins equal to one half.”

steps.title: Strike and pocket
steps.text: Flick the striker. If you pocket a coin equal to your called target, you keep it — say the matching fraction aloud to claim it.

steps.title: Simplify to score
steps.text: Each pocketed coin must be named in its simplest form. Say “two quarters” and the coin is worth only 1 point — say “one half” and it scores 2.

steps.title: Miss = turn passes
steps.text: If the pocketed coin does not match your call, return it to the centre and play moves to the left.

steps.title: Win the round
steps.text: The round ends when the board is cleared. Highest total of simplified fraction points wins the round — best of three rounds wins the match.

challenges.title: Equivalent Hunt
challenges.brief: Pocket three different coins that all equal one half, naming each correctly (e.g. 2/4, 3/6, 5/10).

challenges.title: Simplification Streak
challenges.brief: Simplify five pocketed coins in a row without a mistake — a single slip resets the streak.

challenges.title: Fraction Sum
challenges.brief: Combine two pocketed coins that add to exactly one whole. Announce the pair and the total before pocketing the next coin.

challenges.title: Bullseye Bonus
challenges.brief: Call and pocket the coin worth 3/12 — and immediately state its simplest form. Only the fastest fraction in the room earns the full 25.

scorecard.scoring: 2 points per correctly simplified coin. +3 per challenge completed. Deduct 1 point for a wrongly named fraction.
